scope: Read-only source and retained-evidence acquisition decision for original PR3 L03; no new simulation, inference, publication, native solver, ODE, repository write, or dispatch claim.
source_finding: The checked Planck PR3/FFP10 release evidence does not supply a source-qualified joint FULL/HM1/HM2/OE1/OE2 processed CMB, noise, foreground, weight-estimation and selection law for the retained low-ell morphology statistic. This is a scoped source gap, not a claim that no future or restricted product can exist.

source_map.source: Planck 2018 IV, section 3.5 and noise-bias discussion
source_map.establishes: FFP10 has 999 CMB-only and 300 noise-plus-systematics simulations; fixed observed-data component-separation weights make conditional CMB/noise propagation linear; statistic-dependent noise mismatch and +/-5% sensitivity need assessment.
source_map.does_not_establish: Joint foreground and weight-reselection uncertainty or coverage of this selected low-ell statistic.

source_map.source: Planck 2018 VII, simulation description and footnote 7
source_map.establishes: Full-mission signal/noise realizations are propagated with full-mission weights and permuted into 999 comparison simulations; CMB realization 970 was excluded as corrupted.
source_map.does_not_establish: 999 independent joint signal-noise-foreground draws or an HM/OE lineage and statistic-specific null.

source_map.establishes: 2018 FFP10 released split noise but no half-mission CMB simulations; that paper used 2015 FFP9 half-mission CMB with 2018 SMICA weights and noted effective-beam differences. Its FFP10 noise construction used one fiducial CMB/foreground and retained a weak shared processing residual.
source_map.does_not_establish: A PR3 matched split CMB/foreground joint law for L03; negligible high-L lensing-band impact cannot be transported to this low-ell morphology statistic.

source_map.establishes: Observed FULL/HM/OE SMICA maps and split-specific cautions, including correlated half-ring noise and missing split pixels.
source_map.does_not_establish: Matched null simulation components or split independence.

source_map.establishes: A separate PR4/NPIPE release and product route exist.
source_map.does_not_establish: PR4-to-PR3 calibration transport or a PR3 L03 joint null.

Four actual ID00000 HM/OE noise products through the original operator; independent scoped PASS does not qualify the physical null.

F06/PR4 four-product one-realization diagnostic is a separate release; NESTED CMB and RING residual require index reconciliation and even then lack processed-total/foreground subtraction law.

checked_routes: D04 completed ID00000 split-noise processing is reused; additional nominal IDs alone cannot supply split signal, common residual foreground, or weight-selection law.
Planck VIII's FFP9 half-mission CMB substitution is an explicit different-release, different-effective-beam route requiring response qualification, not a filename-equivalent PR3 component.

F06 PR4/NPIPE MC00200 quartet is already acquired and scoped-reviewed; its processed total, foreground/subtraction law and exact observed split operator remain unresolved and it cannot be renamed into PR3 L03.
R23-CMB final reviewed joint split-direction geometry is deterministic on one observed sky; it supplies no independent null ensemble.

Per-split effective beam, fixed weights and any weight fitting/reselection rule, preprocessing, masks and pixel/QU conventions, tied to the observed products and the retained T26846/P30021 selected-support operator.

exact_missing_external_payload.source_search_limit: Targeted published PR3/PR4 papers, official observed-product listing, and retained completed local receipts were checked. No producer correspondence, restricted archive inventory, or new product download was performed; absence beyond the checked sources is UNKNOWN.

analytic_assessment.current_identifiability: For delivered split vectors y_s=g+f_common+f_s+n_s under fixed processing, all split differences cancel g and f_common. The transformation g->g+h, f_common->f_common-h leaves every y_s and difference unchanged. Thus the retained split contrasts alone do not bound common foreground contamination. This is conditional algebra, not a universal no-go theorem.
analytic_assessment.potential_bounded_repair: A source-qualified bound or law for the common and differential residual foreground after the exact processing operator could feed a sensitivity/partial-coverage calculation for the frozen statistic. Its norm, angular response, selection behavior and validity must be supplied before a numerical bound or scientific PASS can be claimed.
